request: Keep private workspace files out of new projects.
scope: Local template distribution and project document rendering.
setup: Run from the PARK checkout using Python and Git.
constraints: Do not modify the source while copying a project.

steps.action: Restrict Git distribution to tracked regular files and render project documents only.

verify.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_template.py -k test_distribution

acceptance.entrypoint: copy_template invoked by the creation CLI
acceptance.given: A checkout contains a tracked file alongside a private untracked file.
acceptance.then: Only the tracked file appears in the distribution.

acceptance.entrypoint: copy_template invoked by the creation CLI
acceptance.given: A tracked entry links to an external private file.
acceptance.then: The generator rejects the link before copying its contents.
